title: Recursive image and inclusion properties of iterated derived couples
statement: The prefix of the iterated image and inclusion assertions for an exact couple, consisting of the seven clauses before the derived E recurrence.

source.place: Section 12.21 (Spectral sequences: exact couples): Lemma 12.21.2 (Tag 011R), proof omitted there; Definition 12.21.1 (Tag 011Q); Definition 12.21.3 (Tag 011S) for the iteration; Remark 12.21.5 (Tag 0AMJ) for the shifted (bigraded) form, whose footnote gives the well-definedness of g'; Lemma 12.21.4 (Tag 011T) for the use of elements T -> X with a test object T.

proof.text: Construct I recursively from identity maps and the canonical derived-D image inclusions of [def-sp-exact-couple]. Construct A recursively by appending the incoming original alpha to the shifted n-fold incoming power. Induction and associativity give the required recurrence prepending alpha; all endpoint transports follow from integer arithmetic.

Induct on n to prove monicity of I: the base is an identity and each successor is a composite of an image inclusion, an isomorphism transporting its endpoint, and the previous mono. The alpha_comm equation in DerivedMaps of [def-sp-exact-couple], composed with the previous I, proves the alpha compatibility equation by induction.

Induct on n for equality of image subobjects. Both base maps are isomorphisms, so their images are top. For the successor let a be the incoming alpha of page n. The epimorphism factorThruImage a followed by I(n+1) is a followed by the endpoint transport and I(n). Image subobjects are unchanged by precomposition with an epimorphism in an abelian category [def-sp-abelian]. Apply the compatibility equation to replace this by I(n) at the incoming bidegree followed by the original incoming alpha. Factoring each morphism through its epimorphic image projection shows that equal image subobjects give equal images after postcomposition. Use the inductive equality and the appended-alpha recurrence to obtain the image of A(n+1). Source/library details: Mathlib image.fac and imageSubobject_arrow_comp; WeilConjectures.Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Subobject.Limits.imageSubobject_comp_of_epi.
Assemble the explicitly constructed families, their recurrences, monicity, image equalities, and compatibility into the seven conjunctions.

split_report.summary: Read Stacks homology.tex Section 12.21 (Lemma 011R, proof omitted; Definitions 011Q, 011S; Lemma 011T; Remark 0AMJ with its footnote) and Section 12.5 (Lemmas 08N5, 05PK, 010C). Statement generalized from the type-0 couple of def-sp-exact-couple to an exact couple of type s (g of bidegree (s,-s)), which the iteration needs: the derived couple of a type-0 couple has g' of bidegree (1,-1), so the induction for C_r runs over types r-2; for s=0 the statement is the old one. Claims stated as before (ker d, im d, well-definedness of alpha', f', g', exactness of the derived couple, D_r = im alpha^{r-2}, bidegrees). Proof written in 12 steps: element calculus with elements T -> X up to epimorphic refinement (Stacks 011T/08N5; Mathlib Refinements.lean, new Mathlib-leaf node lem-sp-abelian-refinements), d o d = 0, the two subobject identities, the three constructions by universal properties (epi = cokernel of its kernel, def-sp-abelian), the three exactness chases, assembly, and the induction on r. No Freyd-Mitchell; differences of elements are differences in Hom(T,X). Proof is agent-written (Stacks omits it). Searches: the item's earlier five plus leansearch, leanfinder and grep; Mathlib has no exact couples.

theorem pageCouple_image_prefix {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C]
    (X : BigradedExactCouple C 0) :
    ∃ (A : ∀ (n : ℕ) (p q : ℤ), X.D (p + n) (q - n) ⟶ X.D p q)
      (I : ∀ (n : ℕ) (p q : ℤ), (X.pageCouple n).D p q ⟶ X.D p q),
      (∀ p q : ℤ, A 0 p q = eqToHom (by congr 1 <;> omega)) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (p q : ℤ), A (n + 1) p q =
        X.alpha (p + (n + 1 : ℕ)) (q - (n + 1 : ℕ)) ≫
          eqToHom (by congr 1 <;> omega) ≫ A n p q) ∧
      (∀ p q : ℤ, I 0 p q = 𝟙 (X.D p q)) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (p q : ℤ), I (n + 1) p q =
        (X.pageCouple n).derivedDInclusion p q ≫ I n p q) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (p q : ℤ), Mono (I n p q)) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (p q : ℤ), imageSubobject (I n p q) = imageSubobject (A n p q)) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (p q : ℤ),
        (X.pageCouple n).alpha p q ≫ I n (p - 1) (q + 1) =
          I n p q ≫ X.alpha p q)
